d: We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the delivery of major road, transport infrastructure, and utility projects in Riyadh. The successful candidate will have a strong background managing projects from the consultancy/client representative side, with proven experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams, stakeholders, and project delivery activities across complex infrastructure programs.

This role is ideally suited to professionals with direct experience in roads, highways, transportation networks, utilities, and related infrastructure projects. Candidates with predominantly building, architectural, contractor execution, or design-focused backgrounds will not be considered.
q: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
Minimum 10+ years of experience in project management within road, transport infrastructure, and utility projects.
Demonstrated experience working for engineering consultancies, project management consultancies, or as a client representative on major infrastructure programs.
Strong understanding of project controls, contract administration, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.
Proven experience managing consultant-led infrastructure projects in Saudi Arabia or the GCC.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Professional certifications such as PMP, PMO, or equivalent are preferred.
Western education (Bachelor's or Master's degree from a recognized Western university) is highly preferred.
Fluent English communication skills; Arabic language capability is advantageous.
Strong consultancy background rather than contractor-led delivery.
Experience managing transportation, roads, highways, utility corridors, and infrastructure programs.
Demonstrated success in client-facing project leadership roles.
Familiarity with Saudi Arabian infrastructure projects and regulatory environments.
Able to lead multiple stakeholders while maintaining schedule, budget, and quality objectives.
Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. Join us and be part of delivering infrastructure that makes a lasting impact on communities across Saudi Arabia.
r: Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and successful delivery of road, transport infrastructure, and utility projects.
Act as the primary point of contact between clients, consultants, authorities, and project stakeholders.
Manage project scope, schedule, budget, risk, and quality objectives.
Coordinate multidisciplinary consultant teams to ensure timely delivery of project milestones.
Oversee consultant performance and ensure compliance with contractual obligations.
Monitor project progress and prepare regular reports for senior stakeholders.
Identify and mitigate project risks while implementing effective corrective actions.
Facilitate engagement with relevant government authorities and utility providers.
Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with local regulations, standards, and client requirements.
Support strategic decision-making through effective project governance and stakeholder management.

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Sales Director to join our team in Saudi Arabia. This role is critical for driving business development and expanding our footprint across the region. The ideal candidate will have experience building relationships with Energy, Utilities, and Oil & Gas organizations, leveraging their network and expertise to drive growth in these sectors.

Working autonomously, the Sales Director will collaborate closely with the EMEA leadership to develop and execute strategic sales initiatives. This position will oversee the full sales cycle across Saudi Arabia and Middle East, serving as the primary point of contact while collaborating with a virtual portfolio team to engage, retain, enable, and expand Energy Exemplar’s customer base.
r: Drive new business sales across Saudi Arabia, targeting Energy, Utilities, and Oil & Gas organizations.
Meet or exceed assigned financial sales targets and quarterly performance goals.
Build, manage, and maintain a healthy, high-quality pipeline using CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
Partner closely with Sales and marketing to execute targeted sales campaigns, creating pipeline within both new prospects and existing accounts.
Conduct outbound prospecting and networking across all stakeholder levels from end users to senior executives, using value-based selling to address customer pain points.
Develop and maintain a strong understanding of regional market segments, regulatory environments, and key applications for Energy Exemplar solutions.
Perform ongoing market research to identify new prospects, emerging markets, and service opportunities across Saudi Arabia.
Represent Energy Exemplar in the region through industry events, conferences, and local networks to build brand visibility and generate new leads.
Collaborate internally with product, technical, and customer success teams to ensure alignment between customer needs and solution capabilities.
8+ years’ experience in driving net new enterprise software sales or consulting.
Significant experience in Energy, Utilities, or Oil & Gas sectors.
Consistent record of achieving targets and goals in a sales setting.
Strong customer-facing experience leading enterprise-type customers through business or technology transformations with large account/project management experience.
Proven track record of success in driving new business sales within a developing or high-growth region.
Ability to travel within the region as required.
